reason: A more directly targets low friction and wear over the whole range through a low-shear solid-lubricant tribofilm, although it needs defined h-BN content/load and evidence addressing oxidation near 800 °C. B improperly extrapolates from an Al-containing BCC laser-clad coating to FCC CoCrFeNi, appears to confuse W0.5 stoichiometry with 0.5 at.% W, and provides little basis for reduced room-temperature friction or W-rich intermetallic formation at that dilute level.
